## Appendix 3 - R Workflows and GitHub template

The files generated in the [<u>EventMeasure Exports</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#appendix-2---how-to-download-and-summarise-annotation-data) section of this manual are the input files required for the [<u>Synthesis</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses) template, which can be accessed [<u>here</u>](https://github.com/UWA-Marine-Ecology-Group-syntheses/template-synthesis). Running the [<u>Synthesis</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses) script produces the output files that are ready to be uploaded to the [<u>Synthesis</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses) on GlobalArchive.

- Below is an example of the files that will be generated from this script.

- This script can be used the combine the data of multiple [<u>Campaigns</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#campaign) into 1 file<img src="images/image11.png" style="width:6.25in;height:0.76042in" />
